item.title: Soft robots don't have hard joints or gears. They're made of rubbery material…
item.description:
Soft robots don't have hard joints or gears. They're made of rubbery materials like silicone and move by pumping in air, so they bend, squeeze and grip like an octopus arm.
That makes them safe around people and gentle enough to pick a strawberry.

item.description:
We built a soft robot gripper in a weekend: silicone fingers that curl when you pump in air. Gentle enough to pick up an egg.
Sat: 3D print molds, cast Ecoflex Sun: seal, leak-test, add an Arduino + mini pump
